pages.text: $(bold)Wizard Armor$() is the $(bold)modular armor set$() added by this mod; all four pieces are built the same way.$(br2)At the $(bold)Tinker Station$(): put the $(bold)plating$(), the $(bold)maille$() and the $(bold)robe lace$() into their slots; the $(bold)leggings$() and $(bold)boots$() also need one $(bold)magic cloth$() each, consumed while assembling.

$(bold)Where the armor value comes from$(): only the material in the $(bold)plating$() slot.$(br2)The other parts add $(bold)durability$() and their own $(bold)material traits$().$(br2)So $(bold)every piece can mix materials$(): plating for armor value, lace and maille for traits.

$(bold)The four pieces and their platings$():$(li)$(bold)Wizard Hat$() - helmet plating$(li)$(bold)Wizard Robe$() - chestplate plating$(li)$(bold)Wizard Leggings$() - leggings plating$(li)$(bold)Wizard Boots$() - boots plating$(br2)All four also take one $(bold)maille$() and one $(bold)robe lace$() each.

$(bold)How to make them$():$(li)1. Build the parts at the $(bold)Part Builder$() with a blank pattern plus materials$(li)2. Place the parts into their slots at the $(bold)Tinker Station$()$(li)3. Add the magic cloth for the two pieces that consume it$(br2)(Robe lace = 2 materials; casting from fluid works too.)

$(bold)Three traits$(): each of the four pieces carries three $(bold)Wizard Armor exclusive traits$() (no levels, independent of material); wearing any single piece activates them.$(li)$(l:trait_mana_surge)Mana Surge$() - per-piece max mana, spell power and spell damage$(li)$(l:trait_mana_shield)Mana Shield$() - reduces magic damage, raises max health$(li)$(l:trait_all_paths_one)All Paths Are One$() - mana / curse / soul cover each other

$(bold)They live in the tool definition$(), so only armor that still has these traits benefits.$(br2)Wash a trait off with a $(l:trait_overview)Modifier Crystal$() and its effect goes with it.$(br2)$(italic)While the armor is broken (durability exhausted) none of these apply - repair it to get them back.$()

$(bold)The pattern at the Tinker Station$(): all four pieces share one selection pattern (shipped with this mod), which brings up the Wizard Armor slot layout - nothing to draw yourself.$(br2)$(italic)The armor texture is rendered by Tinkers' armor rendering and is unrelated to that pattern.$()
